lost.title: Lost connection to ReactCraft
lost.body: Trying to reconnect. You can keep editing once the connection is back.

welcome.title: Welcome to ReactCraft
welcome.subtitle: This folder has no workspace yet. Create one to start designing.
welcome.storage: The design is saved as JSON files in the .reactcraft/ folder right here. You can commit it to Git with your source code.

form.name: Workspace name
form.mode: Which screen do you design for first?
form.desktopFirstHelp: Design for large screens, then adjust for tablets and phones.
form.mobileFirstHelp: Design for phones, then expand to larger screens.
form.localeHelp: Language of the website you design: used for sample data and for number, currency and date formats. Separate from the Studio interface language.

errors.name: Name the workspace, up to 64 characters.
errors.frameSize: Frames are 320 to 3840 px wide and 320 to 2160 px high.

workspaceError.title: Cannot open the workspace
workspaceError.intro: Some workspace files are broken. ReactCraft does not open a workspace in part, so nothing is overwritten and lost. Restore from a backup, or fix the file by hand and press Try again.
workspaceError.noBackup: This file has no backup yet. Fix it by hand.
